method: Primary-agent manual comparison of the completed partial Korean collection with its fixed originals; no independent review is claimed. Awkward/ambiguous wording is not automatically classified as a proved numerical contradiction.

findings.issue: Faithful Beta backup wording falsely rejected
findings.candidate: Project Beta 는 92 리터를 저장하며 append-only 로그 파일을 사용하고, 일요일에도 쓰기를 허용합니다. 또한 백업은 하루에 두 번 실행됩니다.
findings.observation: The supplied Beta original establishes the included facts, but the verifier marked 하루에 두 번 unestablished. The fallback repeats the English original.

The source says it stores 92 litres. The generated postposed 용량 wording is awkward and can suggest capacity; its storage verb makes a definite capacity-change judgment uncertain. It remains a manual quality finding, without adding a fixture-specific regex.

findings.issue: Repeated neutral headings and omitted planned section
findings.observation: Title and two headings were replaced with neutral labels; an empty third planned section was omitted, and an English original repeats already included Beta facts.

preserved_correct_facts: Alpha capacity 37 litres, SQLite use, Sunday write pause and daily backup are present.
Beta stored amount 92 litres, log-file use, Sunday permission and twice-daily backups are present, with the volume-wording qualification.
Both scoped source originals are completely processed and cited from exact SourceSession metadata.
